description: The VALIDATE facility's data description syntax - the ISO §2023:13.16.2 validation-clauses group (CLASS §2023:13.18.11, DEFAULT §2023:13.18.17, DESTINATION §2023:13.18.18, INVALID WHEN §2023:13.18.31, PRESENT WHEN format 2 §2023:13.18.41, VARYING's validation leg §2023:13.18.64, VALIDATE-STATUS / VAL-STATUS §2023:13.18.62) and the §2023:13.18.63 format-5 content-validation tail of a level-88 VALUE clause ([IS|ARE] {VALID|INVALID} [WHEN condition-1]). A COBOL-2002 introduction with the facility. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the 1985 data description entry (§1985:VI.5.3.2) prints level-number, data-name-1/FILLER, REDEFINES, EXTERNAL, GLOBAL, PICTURE, USAGE, SIGN, OCCURS, SYNCHRONIZED, JUSTIFIED, BLANK WHEN ZERO and `[VALUE IS literal-1]` and nothing else (§1985:VI.5.3.3 SR2: 'The remaining clauses may be written in any order'), and its level-88 format 3 ends at the VALUE literals with no VALID or INVALID phrase; §2002:13.14.1 adds `[ validation-clauses ]` ('where validation-clauses is:' class-clause, default-clause, DESTINATION, INVALID WHEN, PRESENT WHEN, VARYING, validate-status-clause), §2002:13.16.61.1 prints 'Format 5 (content-validation-entry)' with `[ IS | ARE ] { INVALID | VALID } [ WHEN condition-1 ]`, §2002:13.16.61.3 GR23 gives it its meaning ('Each entry with the VALID phrase defines a set of allowable values or ranges of values for the associated data item'), §2002:F.1 item 6 lists DEFAULT, PRESENT, VALID, VALIDATE-STATUS and VAL-STATUS among 'The following reserved words have been added', and §2002:F.2 item 143 states the change: 'The new data division clauses CLASS, DEFAULT, DESTINATION, INVALID, PRESENT WHEN, VALIDATE-STATUS, and VARYING were also added ... These clauses, together with the VALID, INVALID and WHEN phrases of the level-88 VALUE clause'. §2014:13.16.1 and §2014:13.18.63.3 GR21 keep both, so 2014 = 2023 (2023 marks them obsolete, VCR rows 117-124). DECLINED (Annex A.4.14; docs/CONFORMANCE.md §4 item 3): from 2002 DeclinedFacilityPass refuses each clause by name with COBOL1708, so the row is refused at every edition, by its introduction gate below 2002 and by the decline from it. The grammar arms are the UNION grammar (kb/Work PB5007 removed the {is2002()}? construct gates PB2291 recorded) and the VersionConformancePass parse arms (VisitValidationClause, VisitValidateValidPhrase) name the edition on RECOGNITION. A COBOL-85 program that declares DEFAULT, PRESENT or VALID as a name keeps it: the reservation gate retypes every occurrence of the declared word to a user-defined word (kb/Work PB655, PB4958).
display: a data description clause of the VALIDATE facility
